title: TheFighters Online
description:
Developer NoteThis game was created as a passion project by a solo indie developer.
Development is no longer active, and the game is provided as-is for those who wish to experience it or explore the early work of the developer.

Thank you for your understanding — and for supporting indie games.

Indie fighting game

The game contains 3 game methods

1- Chapters

2- Local multiplayer (3D)

3- Online ( 3D )In the Online mode, you are going to face a real person and fight them to get more and more ranks to open your mission and get EXP to build your own character and make him stronger, 

there are 5 Ranks in the game for each rank you are going to get EXP to build your ability,

for each win, you are going to get 2 points

if you lost the game, you are going to lose 2 points

if you faced any problems, please send an email to (skullsameh.work@gmail.com)

enjoy
